keys:

A sole win means winning at least one main or side pot outright. Split hands are counted separately and may overlap. A profitable hand has a positive chip change. A hand with no pot awarded is a loss.
Raw chip results are grouped by blinds; BB means big blind. Early exits are not match wins or losses. Hand ranks count only the best five of seven at showdown. Legacy totals cannot reconstruct hand histories or achievements. Assistance filters count actual displayed results, not opening an unavailable panel.

zh_CN: 阶段：%s；需跟注 %d；底池 %d。每个分支都能继续到结算。

keys: 你已完成本课练习。可以重练巩固或进入下一课；教程进度独立保存，不影响普通对战统计。
en: You finished this lesson. Repeat it or move on; tutorial progress is saved separately and does not affect regular results.
zh_CN: 你已完成本课练习。可以重练巩固或进入下一课；教程进度独立保存，不影响普通对战统计。

keys: 同一花色的连续五张；皇家同花顺是其中的 A 高同花顺。
en: Five consecutive cards of one suit. A royal flush is the ace-high straight flush.
zh_CN: 同一花色的连续五张；皇家同花顺是其中的 A 高同花顺。

keys: 四张同点数牌，加一张踢脚牌。
en: Four cards of one rank, plus a kicker.
zh_CN: 四张同点数牌，加一张踢脚牌。

en: Three of a kind plus a pair.

keys: 五张同一花色，不要求连续。
en: Five cards of one suit, not necessarily consecutive.
zh_CN: 五张同一花色，不要求连续。

keys: 五张连续点数；A 可作 1，A-2-3-4-5 是最小顺子。
en: Five consecutive ranks. Ace can be low: A-2-3-4-5 is the lowest straight.
zh_CN: 五张连续点数；A 可作 1，A-2-3-4-5 是最小顺子。

keys: 三张同点数牌，比较三条点数后比较踢脚牌。
en: Three cards of one rank. Compare the trip rank, then the kickers.
zh_CN: 三张同点数牌，比较三条点数后比较踢脚牌。

keys: 两组对子，先比高对，再比低对，最后比踢脚牌。
en: Two pairs. Compare the higher pair, lower pair, then kicker.
zh_CN: 两组对子，先比高对，再比低对，最后比踢脚牌。

keys: 一组对子；对子相同则依次比较三张踢脚牌。
en: One pair. If tied, compare the three kickers in order.
zh_CN: 一组对子；对子相同则依次比较三张踢脚牌。

keys: 没有更高牌型时比较五张牌的点数。
en: Without a higher hand type, compare the five card ranks in order.
zh_CN: 没有更高牌型时比较五张牌的点数。

keys: 皇家同花顺属于同花顺，不是第十种牌型；公共牌组成的最佳五张牌对所有仍在牌局中的玩家可用。
en: A royal flush is a straight flush, not a tenth hand type. Every remaining player can use the best five cards on the board.
zh_CN: 皇家同花顺属于同花顺，不是第十种牌型；公共牌组成的最佳五张牌对所有仍在牌局中的玩家可用。

keys: 全下后自动发牌，公共牌现在有 %d 张。
zh_CN: 全下后自动发牌，公共牌现在有 %d 张。

keys: 练习资料损坏或版本较新，已保留原文件；当前只读。
en: Practice data is damaged or from a newer version. The original file is preserved; this session is read-only.
zh_CN: 练习资料损坏或版本较新，已保留原文件；当前只读。

keys: 部分牌谱损坏或版本不兼容，已跳过并保留原文件。
en: Some hand histories are damaged or incompatible. They were skipped and the original files preserved.
zh_CN: 部分牌谱损坏或版本不兼容，已跳过并保留原文件。

keys: 牌谱格式无效或来自预设教程，未计入正常战绩。
en: This record is invalid or from a preset tutorial. It was not counted in regular results.
zh_CN: 牌谱格式无效或来自预设教程，未计入正常战绩。

keys: 牌谱已满 1000 手，请手动删除旧牌谱后重试；累计统计与成就保留。
en: The 1000-hand limit is reached. Delete an old history and retry; cumulative statistics and achievements are kept.
zh_CN: 牌谱已满 1000 手，请手动删除旧牌谱后重试；累计统计与成就保留。

en: This valid hand history could not be found.

keys: 牌谱删除失败，原文件与累计统计保留，可以重试。
en: Could not delete the history. The original file and cumulative statistics are kept; retry is available.
zh_CN: 牌谱删除失败，原文件与累计统计保留，可以重试。

keys: 已删除牌谱；累计统计与成就保留。
en: History deleted; cumulative statistics and achievements kept.
zh_CN: 已删除牌谱；累计统计与成就保留。

keys: 整场配置不完整，未记入场次。
en: Match settings are incomplete; the match was not counted.
zh_CN: 整场配置不完整，未记入场次。

keys: 练习资料损坏或版本较新，当前只读，原文件未覆盖。
en: Practice data is damaged or newer; read-only mode preserves the original file.
zh_CN: 练习资料损坏或版本较新，当前只读，原文件未覆盖。

keys: 保存目录不可写，请修复目录后重试；本次数据尚未保存。
en: The save directory is not writable. Fix its permissions and retry; this data is not saved yet.
zh_CN: 保存目录不可写，请修复目录后重试；本次数据尚未保存。

keys: 写入失败，可以重试；原存档保留。
en: Write failed. Retry is available; the previous save is preserved.
zh_CN: 写入失败，可以重试；原存档保留。

keys: 保存失败，可以重试；原存档保留。
en: Save failed. Retry is available; the previous save is preserved.
zh_CN: 保存失败，可以重试；原存档保留。

keys: 偏好资料来自更新版本，已保留原文件；本次使用默认设置且不覆盖。
en: Preferences are from a newer version. The original file is preserved; this session uses defaults without overwriting it.
zh_CN: 偏好资料来自更新版本，已保留原文件；本次使用默认设置且不覆盖。

keys: 部分旧配置无效，已回退到支持的安全配置。
en: Some old settings were invalid and have been reset to supported values.
zh_CN: 部分旧配置无效，已回退到支持的安全配置。

keys:
整场目标：赢得牌桌全部筹码；筹码归零则整场结束。开桌可选人数、筹码和盲注，盲注一场内固定，重新开桌完全免费。

每手用自己的两张底牌与最多五张公共牌选最佳五张。流程为翻前 → 翻牌（三张）→ 转牌（一张）→ 河牌（一张）→ 摊牌；对手全部弃牌时可提前结束。

让牌：无需跟注时免费继续。跟注：补足本轮最高下注，筹码不足时只付剩余筹码。加注到：本轮累计投入的目标总额，不是额外投入。弃牌：放弃本手争夺。全下：投入剩余筹码，但仍受加注权限制。

多人桌翻前从大盲之后开始，翻后从庄位之后第一位可行动者开始。单挑时庄位兼小盲，翻前先行动、翻后后行动。每手庄位轮换。

全下玩家只争夺其投入对应的底池，其余投入形成边池。最佳五张相同则平分，余数按庄位之后的座位顺序分配。无人跟注的多余筹码退回。派奖金额不是净利润，净变化须扣除本手投入。

设置和速览打开期间牌局等待。已完成手牌保存成功后可以跨启动回放；当前未结束的对局不支持续玩。离开时放弃未结算手牌，提前离桌单列。保存失败会明确提示并可重试。
en:
Match goal: win every chip on the table; you are eliminated when your stack reaches zero. Choose player count, stacks, and blinds before starting. Blinds stay fixed for a match and restarting is free.

Use your two hole cards and up to five community cards to choose the best five. Streets are preflop, flop (three cards), turn (one), river (one), then showdown. A hand can end early if every opponent folds.

Check continues for free when there is nothing to call. Call matches the current wager; a short stack pays only its remaining chips. Raise to is your total contribution on this street. Fold gives up the hand. All-in commits the remaining stack, subject to raise rights.

Preflop at a multi-player table starts after the big blind; postflop starts with the first active player after the button. Heads-up, the button is also the small blind and acts first preflop. The button rotates each hand.

All-in players contest only pots covered by their contribution; the rest becomes side pots. Equal best fives split the pot, with odd chips dealt clockwise after the button. Uncalled excess is returned. Payout is not net profit; net change includes this hand's investment.

The game waits while Settings and reference panels are open. Completed hands can be replayed after a successful save; unfinished matches cannot resume after restart. Leaving abandons an unsettled hand and is tracked as an early exit. Save failures are shown and can be retried.
